title.rendered: The Same Power That Raised Christ Lives in You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in you. The power that rolled the stone away is the same power that will see you through this day. Same Spirit. Same power. Same God.

content.rendered:
The Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in you. The power that rolled the stone away is the same power that will see you through this day. Same Spirit. Same power. Same God.

The Gospel For Today | Monday, June 8, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you.”
Romans 8:11 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Sit with this verse for a moment. The Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in you. Not visited you. Not hovered around you. Lives in you. The same Holy Spirit who entered a sealed tomb on the third morning, who flooded the lungs of a crucified corpse with the breath of resurrection life, who unwrapped grave clothes and rolled away stones, has taken up residence in your body. Today. This morning. As you read this.

If that does not change something about how you walk into your day, it has not yet hit you. The greatest power ever displayed in the universe is not at a distance. It is local. It is in your inner being. It is closer to you than your own breath.

And Paul does not leave this as a theological abstraction. He draws the practical conclusion. He who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of His Spirit who lives in you. Your mortal body. The one that gets tired. The one that gets sick. The one that aches when you have not slept. The one that fails sometimes. That same body is being indwelt by the resurrection Spirit, and the resurrection Spirit is constantly speaking life into it.

This means tired is not the final word over you. Discouraged is not the final word over you. Defeated is not the final word over you. Resurrection power is the final word, because the resurrection Spirit lives where your fatigue thought it lived. The grave that thought it had Jesus could not keep Him for three days. The discouragement that thinks it has you cannot keep you because the same Spirit is inside.

Today, when the load feels heavy, when the news feels hopeless, when the body feels weak, remember who is living inside you. The same Spirit. The same power. The same God who emptied a tomb. He has not lost any of His resurrection ability between that morning and this one. And He is yours.

Prayer

Father, thank You that the Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in me. Let resurrection power flood every part of me today. The tired places. The discouraged places. The places where I feel like giving up. Breathe Your life into them, the way You breathed life into Jesus on that morning. Remind me that nothing is too dead for the Spirit who already conquered death. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

The Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead lives in me. The same power that emptied the tomb is at work in my mortal body. I am not running on my own strength. I am carried by resurrection life. Death has no final word over anything in me. The Spirit of Jesus is the final word.
